items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: And in comes Louis you know. “Oh,” he said, “dig old Shearing getting in on the freebies there.” ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, Louis was a great tease.

ctx.x: John Levy, I met John Levy and the group, and John Levy did recording with me before, oh, well about the same time the quintet started. 1949.
Do you get a chance to meet and listen to Louis Armstrong in person?
